variables.name: HANDLED
variables.comment: * Returned by processMessage to indicate the message was processed.

variables.name: NOT_HANDLED
variables.comment: * Returned by processMessage to indicate the message was NOT processed.

methods.name: void enter()
methods.comment: * Called when a state is entered.

methods.name: void exit()
methods.comment: * Called when a state is exited.

methods.name: boolean processMessage(Message msg)
methods.comment:
* Called when a message is to be processed by the
     * state machine.
     *
     * This routine is never reentered thus no synchronization
     * is needed as only one processMessage method will ever be
     * executing within a state machine at any given time. This
     * does mean that processing by this routine must be completed
     * as expeditiously as possible as no subsequent messages will
     * be processed until this routine returns.
     *
     * @param msg to process
     * @return HANDLED if processing has completed and NOT_HANDLED
     *         if the message wasn't processed.

methods.name: String getName()
methods.comment:
* Name of State for debugging purposes.
     *
     * @return name of state.
